notes:
---Summary---
Railstone is building a RAG-backed assistant for Tier 1 support + ticket deflection. Primary goal: increase deflection (self-serve resolution) while keeping agent-assist latency extremely low. They have a large historical ticket corpus and strict residency rules. Interested in Redwood Dedicated for predictable p95 latency and Optimize recommendations for cost.

---Business context / impact---
- Current stack: Elastic + in-house reranker (late-stage fuzzy matching -> cross-encoder rerank). Cost is spiking as ticket volume grows; quality of top-5 results drifts.
- Target KPIs: +15-20% deflection, top-5 precision >= 88-92% on test set, p95 end-to-end rerank <= 220ms (goal 200ms). Cost goal: <$0.03/query average across lookup+rerank for production volume.

---Data / scale---
- Corpus: ~48M ticket events (tickets + replies + KB snapshots) -> expected indexed vectors 30-55M depending on chunking.
- Ingest so far: 18M rows (sanitized) into POC index.
- Retention/residency: US + EU (legal requires EU subset on EU-hosted infra).

---Technical preferences / constraints---
- Embeddings: prefer open models (Mistral/Llama variants) but will evaluate Redwood-verified profiles.
- Reranker: plan: ANN top-K (K=100) -> lightweight cross-encoder rerank for final top-5. Need hardware and kernel choices that keep rerank latency under SLO.
- Indexing: batch rebuild windows nightly; incremental real-time updates for hot tickets. Concerned about storage and cost with 40M+ vectors.
- Caching: want prefix/KV caching + query-level caching for repeated similar queries.

---Security / compliance---
- Must have SOC2 Type II report; SSO/SAML in place; KMS integration required for keys; audit logs retained 2+ years (prefer 7).
- Legal: "We cannot have EU customer content leave EU region for processing" - needs EU-hosted inference and control plane options.

---POC notes (what we're testing)---
- Objective: validate top-5 quality and p95 latency at scaled load (apprx 300 qps burst, 60 qps steady).
- POC config: Dedicated pool (1x A100 equiv) + hosted fallback; quantized 4/8-bit models for rerank baseline; evaluate Redwood Optimize tuning suggestions.
- Measured so far: ANN recall @100 = 0.94 on sample, cross-encoder top-5 precision = 0.86 (need tuning). Median rerank CPU latency ~85ms on 4x vCPU; GPU-based cross-encoder reduced latency to ~45ms but costs up.

---Quotes / call snippets---
- Head of CX: "If we can't serve answers sub-200ms customers will complain and agents will not adopt."
- Director Eng: "Willing to pay premium for stable p95 SLAs; we need bounded worst-case."

---Next steps / action items---
- SE Maya to run 2 additional reranker configs (quantized 13B cross-encoder vs distilled 2B) and deliver top-5 precision/latency matrix by 2025-12-10.
- Pricing: commercial review with Samir — need committed throughput pricing for Dedicated + EU residency add-on.
- Legal: provide Redwood subprocessor list + data residency artifact to Railstone legal (drive link provided).

---Open blockers---
- Legal on EU processing/subprocessors.
- Confirmation on acceptable cost-per-query thresholds from product ops.
- Need longer tail latency testing (99th) under production-like burst pattern.

---CRM shorthand---
POC in flight. Mid-market ARR potential. Eng + CX highly engaged. "If you can hit quality + p95 across EU/NA we have green light for Dedicated commit."
